meta_description:
90K likes, 1,000 comments - sahilkhan on May 14, 2025: "#Repost • @thetrillionairelife Bollywood actor and fitness icon Sahil Khan was recently spotted wearing the iconic Rolex Cosmograph Daytona Rainbow in Everose gold, valued at a staggering $500,000 USD!

This luxurious timepiece is a true masterpiece of craftsmanship. Its 40mm case is forged from 18k Everose gold, paired with a sleek black lacquer dial.

The bezel is set with 36 baguette-cut sapphires in a stunning rainbow gradient, while 56 brilliant-cut diamonds elegantly adorn the lugs and crown guard. The hour markers are crafted from 11 baguette-cut sapphires, each matching the color of the corresponding section of the bezel.

Powered by Rolex’s in-house Caliber 4130, this chronograph not only showcases unparalleled luxury but also boasts exceptional precision and durability.

The Rolex Daytona Rainbow is a collector’s dream, with its rarity and vibrant design making it one of the most coveted models in the world of haute horology.

Would you invest $500,000 in a watch like this? 🤔  #TheTrillionaireLife #Sahilkhan".
